image_description: A grand, ornate pipe organ situated within a church or cathedral setting. The instrument features multiple tiers of vertical metal pipes of varying heights and diameters, arranged symmetrically around a central decorative case. The casing is elaborately carved wood with gold leaf accents. A wooden console with keyboards is visible at the base, though partially obscured by shadow and angle. To the right, a decorative balcony railing is visible.
